reviews.comment: Professor White was awesome! I only showed up to his class a little throughout the semester because it was at 8am. Some assignments I had to turn in late and he was very understanding and always gave me full credit. Would've gotten a higher grade if I just showed up and did the discussions. If u show up and do all assignments, Easy A!

Very good at holding attention. I never have a problem staying awake in his 8am class and he always has cool artifacts to look at. Introduce yourself to him and make conversation and he'll open right up to you.
I only went to class three times the en tire semester and I'm ending with an A. Very easy course. Not the best professor, but skipping class won't affect your grade.

Overall, Professor White is a good professor for 205. The lectures were interesting, and he did well teaching the topics. There is an assignment book and a graphic novel, and some reading homework. Also, there is a final project. Show an interest in class, and you will do well. I learned a lot and would recommend taking his class.

Was the TA for my class & was horrible. Mumbles so bad you can't hear him nor would you want to. Speaks in the most annoying tone of voice that I tried to tune him out. When I did have questions, he never really answered, he would just ramble on. Hard grader, got MANY points off hw's VOCAB sections! *eye roll*. IMPOSSIBLE to read his handwriting
